design: Tall graceful adult female archivist with an elongated oval forehead, long fine lower mandibles and dark-to-silver dreadlocks gathered into two low loops. Long sleeveless charcoal robe with diagonal cream wrap and single wide slate-blue stole, narrow bronze waist rings. Left arm holds a closed thin book to the chest while the right palm offers a single blank ceramic memory tile. Light brown mottled hide.
